comments.author: Erda
comments.body:
Decent aide for handicrafts (handicrafts aide skills + luxuries and alcohol trading), but almost useless for everything else.

It still helps a lot for *grinding* HC with the sherry bordeaux route (wine -> brandy, brandy + raisins -> sherry). But I believe it becomes worse in late game than for instance Nicola (who has collection).
